item.description:
• Posters now come in 4:5 and 1:1 as well, plus a new Minimal template. Neon, Film and Magazine are Pro templates you can preview first
  • Pro vivid colors: Prism, Holo, Neon Pulse and Aurora Flow shift as you type, with a 30-second trial
  • Pro custom colors: up to 4, with three colors, brightness and flow speed
  • Rename a take right on its card; exporting from the library opens the card so you can pick size and template
  • Replays play your current sound, stop with a second click, and only one plays at a time
  • Hover a color or sound to see its name; unlocked Pro items are marked in gold
  • The installer now shows the Cadence icon

• 海报新增 4:5、1:1 两种尺寸，并新增简约模板；霓虹、胶片、杂志为 Pro 模板，可先预览
  • Pro 炫彩配色：幻彩、全息、霓虹脉冲、极光流动，颜色随演出流动，可试用 30 秒
  • Pro 自定义配色：最多 4 个，可调三种颜色、亮度与流动速度
  • 片段卡可直接修改标题；片段库点导出会打开片段卡选择尺寸和模板
  • 回放带上当前音效，再点一次即可停止，同一时间只回放一段
  • 配色与音效悬停时显示名称；Pro 项解锁后以金色标记
  • 安装包显示 Cadence 图标
